historical_comparison.notebook_validation_split: None (trained on full dataset without holdout split)
historical_comparison.notebook_leakage_note: No test/val split was performed in the original Final.ipynb notebook. Evaluation on train set alone overstates generalization.

baseline_comparison.baseline_model: Unigram Frequency Baseline (Predicts most frequent training tokens)

generalization_gap_analysis.train_test_gap_explanation: High train accuracy (83.5%) vs test accuracy (15.2%) reflects sequence memorization typical of small-vocabulary LSTMs without pretrained transformers. However, BiLSTM Top-1 (15.18%) and Top-5 (27.44%) vastly outperform the unigram baseline (Top-1: 3.87%) and random guessing (0.014%), demonstrating genuine sequential syntactic and semantic learning.
